newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish unemployment falls to two million, PM says.
newsitem.headline: Polish unemployment falls to two million, PM says.

text.p: Poland's unemployment fell to about two million in May from 2.13 million in April as some 100,000 people found jobs, Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz said on Sunday.

"According to data passed to me by the labour minister, another 100,000 people found new jobs in May and unemployment fell to two million," Cimoszewicz told a news conference in the southern city of Krakow.
In April, there were 2.13 million people unemployed, or 12.4 percent of the active labour force.
